description: Insert activation observers into a qconfig-tagged linear model.
prompt:
import torch
assert torch.__version__ == "2.2.0"
import torch.nn as nn


def observed_activation_range():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = nn.Linear(4, 2)
    model.qconfig = torch.ao.quantization.get_default_qconfig("fbgemm")
    torch.ao.quantization.propagate_qconfig_(model)
right_context:
x = torch.randn(8, 4)
    _ = model(x)
    observer = model.activation_post_process
    return observer.min_val, observer.max_val, model(x)
assertions:
min_val, max_val, out = observed_activation_range()
assert min_val.shape == torch.Size([])
assert max_val.shape == torch.Size([])
assert float(min_val) <= float(out.min())
assert float(max_val) >= float(out.max())
assert float(min_val) < 0.0 < float(max_val)

description: Collect the activation observers of a prepared model into a dict.
prompt:
import torch
assert torch.__version__ == "2.2.0"
import torch.nn as nn


def collect_observers():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(4, 4), nn.Linear(4, 2))
    model.qconfig = torch.ao.quantization.get_default_qconfig("fbgemm")
    prepared = torch.ao.quantization.prepare(model)
    _ = prepared(torch.randn(8, 4))
    collected = {}
assertions:
observers = collect_observers()
assert set(observers) == {"0.activation_post_process", "1.activation_post_process"}
assert all(obs.__class__.__name__ == "HistogramObserver" for obs in observers.values())
assert all(float(obs.min_val) < float(obs.max_val) for obs in observers.values())
new_completion: collected.update({name + ".activation_post_process": mod.activation_post_process for name, mod in prepared.named_modules() if hasattr(mod, "activation_post_process")})
